title: Drum makes, pedals, cymbals and 5A sticks
summary: He liked a Leedy snare and Ludwig bass drum, describes the old overhead pedals, cymbals hooked to the bass drum, and medium 5A sticks like Chandler and Cantrell used.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used

blocks.x: Mm-hm. What make drum do you use and what make did you like when you were a boy? What kind of a drum, what make?
Well, I always liked a little Edel snare drum and a Ludwig bass drum.
Was there any certain make like Ludwig or Leedy or Duplex or what make? Yeah, or the Heater. Any of them was good? Yeah, they were good.
A Leedy snare drum, he said, huh? A Ludwig bass drum. And that's for the street? Well, that's for street orchestra too. And what kind of pedals would you use?

Well, at that time, years ago, they used to use them overhead pedals. Well, see, they never had those short pedals out yet. You know, they just had them overhead pedals, or a rod on it about that long, and a ball at it. And the pedal part was made out of wood set on the floor with a spring on it. And then, years, he used to pattern that thing used to hit the bass drum.
Well, what about the cymbals? Were they, how did the cymbal work then?
Well, we had cymbal holders.
They wouldn't be attached to the beat or anything, that long.
What, to the drum?
To the beat up. Did you ever use a cymbal attached to the pedal?
You know? Oh no, it wasn't attached to the pedal.
I have heard of that, I just wondered if you'd have...
It was hooked onto the bass drum and got on the side of the pedal. Well, the pedal had a rod on it with a knob.
Yeah, I've seen those, I know what you mean.
It was till they hit that cymbal.
Yeah, when the cymbals attached to the bass drum.
Yeah, yeah, the cymbals went onto the bass drum.
How big a cymbal did you use in those days?
Well, a cymbal about that big.
About a 10 inch cymbal. Yeah, about 10 inch. What kind of sticks did you use? And what kind of sticks do you like now? Light sticks or heavy sticks? What kind of sticks did you use?
No, no, no, I like medium sticks. That's the 5A sticks.
5A. You know what kind D.D. Chandler used out in the street? Big ones or little ones? What were they like? Same kind. Same kind, about 5A.
Yeah, 5A. That ain't too light and it ain't too heavy.
Who makes it?
Oh, one day.
I guess the Omega, that's just the standard way to grade them.
Yeah, that's the standard number of sticks.
Do you remember old man Contrell, what kind of sticks he used? Same kind. Not real heavy, not the great big heavy ones?
No, no, not the big heavy ones. No, no, not the big heavy ones.
Sometimes in the streets they try to use those great big heavy ones for outdoors. Yeah, but no, no.
You didn't use those? No, I used my same ones like I used in the office too.
